cover_letter:
Dear Timefold Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my keen interest in the Digital Experience Manager position, a role that perfectly aligns with my expertise in digital marketing, web operations, and SEO, and my ambition to drive tangible pipeline impact. Timefold’s commitment to freeing the world from wasteful scheduling through intelligent planning is inspiring, and I am particularly drawn to the opportunity to own the digital touchpoints for your technically sophisticated audience of developers and technical buyers.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained hands-on experience owning the end-to-end process of website content management and optimization. This includes performing keyword research, writing and publishing SEO-targeted blog content, building and maintaining WordPress client sites, and meticulously tracking performance using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs. This experience directly prepares me to manage timefold.ai as your most important commercial asset, ensuring content accuracy, SEO best practices, and functional conversion paths.

My personal project, mirook.com, further showcases my ability to independently manage and optimize a digital presence. I designed and built the multi-page WordPress site, integrated social media, and implemented advanced technical SEO and GEO strategies, including structured data and entity optimization, to significantly improve search visibility. This project highlights my proactive approach to website performance and my capacity to act as the first line of defense for digital issues, ensuring uptime and conversion integrity.

Furthermore, my background as a Front-End Developer and coursework in Computer Science provide me with a solid technical understanding, which I believe is crucial for effective collaboration with developers and for deeply understanding Timefold’s product. I am adept at coordinating digital assets and eager to apply my skills in social media content management and performance reporting to expand Timefold’s reach and engagement. My commitment to continuous learning, combined with a quick adaptability to new tools, positions me to excel in driving conversion rate optimization and evolving into a genuine digital marketing expert within your team.

I am enthusiastic about the prospect of contributing to Timefold from your Ghent office and am confident I can make an immediate impact on your digital experience. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
